property.name: query.max-memory
property.description: Maximum distributed user memory per query. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: query.max-memory-per-node
property.description: Maximum user memory per query per node. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: query.max-history
property.description: Completed queries retained in memory. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: query.max-length
property.description: Maximum query text length in characters. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: query.max-stage-count
property.description: Maximum stages per query. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: query.max-run-time
property.description: Maximum elapsed query time, including queueing. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: task.concurrency
property.description: Local parallelism per task; must be a power of two. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: node-scheduler.include-coordinator
property.description: Allow the coordinator to execute tasks. Applies to the coordinator only. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.
